reuse.why: Adds the option to the existing getCategoriesForBulkAction that the bulk actions already share, but leaves copyPreviousMonth on its own inline copy of the exclusion rules, so that month-wide action does not get the flag.

duplication.why: Adds no new copy, but does not fold copyPreviousMonth's separate hidden/group-hidden/#fixed/template checks into the shared selection, so the hidden rule still lives in two places.

placement.why: The hidden toggle is inside the shared bulk-action category query in budget/actions.ts, where the other exclusions already live.

scope.why: Focused on the flag and a test, though several new lines and the test are left unformatted past the project's line width.

maintainability.why: The parameterised query is clean, but one month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth) silently ignores includeHiddenCategories because it decides hidden categories on its own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff routes every action it touches through getCategoriesForBulkAction; the pre-existing bypass in copyPreviousMonth (its own checks over getBudgetData rows) is left untouched rather than added.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic duplicated by the diff.
